source.publication: 2025 PIT-RES Resident Individual Income Tax Return Instructions and Form PIT-RES 2025; tax rate schedule from 30 Del. C. §1102(a)(14)
source.section: Instructions PDF p.6 Line 6 Pension Exclusion (under-60 rules, 60-or-over worksheet lines 1-4, eligible retirement income, NOTE, example); Form PIT-RES Lines 1-12, 20a-24, 26-27b, 32-33; Instructions PDF p.5 Line 1; PDF p.8 Line 20a standard deduction table, Line 24, Line 27a; PDF p.9 Line 27b; tax rate schedule 30 Del. C. §1102(a)(14) (record brackets cite)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 40,050.00 + ira distribution (you) 10,000.00 = 50,050.00. Federal taxable income = 50,050.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 34,300.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form PIT-RES (filing status 1 single, Column B): Line 1 federal AGI 50,050.00; Line 2 other states' obligations interest 0.00; Line 3 0.00; Line 4 total 50,050.00. Line 5 U.S. obligations interest 0.00. Line 6 pension exclusion 0.00. Line 7 0.00; Line 8a 0.00; Line 8b 0.00. Line 9 (Lines 5-8b) = 0.00. Line 10 = 50,050.00 - 0.00 = 50,050.00. Line 11 0.00 (Line 11 worksheet: under 60 and not disabled). Line 12 Delaware AGI = 50,050.00. Line 20a standard deduction (filing status 1) 3,250.00; Line 21 additional standard deduction 0 box(es) for 65 or over x 2,500.00 = 0.00; Line 22 = 3,250.00. Line 23 taxable income = 50,050.00 - 3,250.00 = 46,800.00. Line 24 tax, §1102(a)(14) schedule as numbers: 2.2% x 3,000.00 = 66.00 + 3.9% x 5,000.00 = 195.00 + 4.8% x 10,000.00 = 480.00 + 5.2% x 5,000.00 = 260.00 + 5.55% x 21,800.00 = 1,209.90; total 2,210.90 (the Division's tax table, not in the sources, would give a row figure; expected keeps the formula). Line 25 0.00; Line 26 = 2,210.90. Line 27a personal credits 1 x 110.00 = 110.00; Line 27b additional credits 0 box(es) for 60 or over x 110.00 = 0.00; Line 32 total non-refundable credits 110.00. Line 33 balance = 2,210.90 - 110.00 = 2,100.90. Born 1966-03-01, so past 59 1/2 and the distribution is not an early one; the booklet's under-60 rule speaks only of 'your pension', and the projection gives no exclusion for an IRA distribution under 60 (approximation), so Line 6 is 0.00. If the 2,000 applied, Line 6 would be 2,000.00 and the tax 2,000.00 x 5.55% = 111.00 lower.
accepted_approximations: For a person under 60, IRA and 401(k) distributions, annuities and Roth conversions are left out of the 2,000 non-military pension exclusion (the booklet speaks only of a pension).
